svg.title: Per-camera decode and RAW to RGB times
svg.desc: Canon EOS R5 (RAW): decode FlashRaw 80.9 ms, LibRaw 138 ms, rawler 237 ms; Canon EOS 5D Mark IV (RAW): decode FlashRaw 20.5 ms, LibRaw 431 ms, RawSpeed 110 ms, rawler 251 ms; Nikon Z8 (14-bit lossless): decode FlashRaw 44.0 ms, LibRaw 544 ms, RawSpeed 218 ms, rawler 356 ms; Nikon Z6III (lossless): decode FlashRaw 25.0 ms, LibRaw 285 ms, RawSpeed 110 ms, rawler 186 ms; Sony A7 IV (compressed): decode FlashRaw 5.86 ms, LibRaw 87.4 ms, RawSpeed 8.77 ms, rawler 8.38 ms; Sony A7R V (lossless): decode FlashRaw 33.2 ms, LibRaw 761 ms, RawSpeed 24.2 ms, rawler 61.3 ms; Fujifilm X-T5 (lossless compressed): decode FlashRaw 35.5 ms, LibRaw 151 ms, RawSpeed 44.4 ms, rawler 93.9 ms; Panasonic Lumix S5II: decode FlashRaw 15.1 ms, LibRaw 131 ms, RawSpeed 62.4 ms, rawler 119 ms; OM System OM-1 Mark II: decode FlashRaw 116 ms, LibRaw 381 ms, RawSpeed 162 ms, rawler 225 ms; Leica M10-R: decode FlashRaw 28.9 ms, LibRaw 559 ms, RawSpeed 197 ms, rawler 381 ms; Hasselblad X2D 100C (compressed): decode FlashRaw 76.6 ms, LibRaw 1013 ms, RawSpeed 451 ms; Google Pixel 8 Pro: decode FlashRaw 23.1 ms, LibRaw 656 ms, RawSpeed 18.9 ms, rawler 34.2 ms
svg.text: Apple M1 Ultra, all cores, median of 7 runs · log scale, left is faster
Missing marker: that library does not decode the file (RawSpeed: Canon CR3; rawler: Hasselblad X2D). Full tables: docs/benchmarks.md.
